\begin{example} \end{example}[Additive separation of variables for the Hamilton--Jacobi equation] ↗ ex:hamilton-jacobi-complete-integral 1. ch4:4.1-ex-3\group Separation of Variables

For $u_t+H(Du)=0$, the additive ansatz $u=w(x)+v(t)$ gives $H(Dw)=\mu =-v'(t)$. Hence every solution of $H(Dw)=\mu $ produces \[ u(x,t)=w(x)-\mu t+b. \] In particular, $w(x)=a\cdot x$ yields $u=a\cdot x-H(a)t+b$. \end{example}
